# Thunderbird Chapter — Signal Corps Regimental Association

> Official site of the Thunderbird Chapter of the Signal Corps Regimental Association (SCRA): events, sponsorship, board, awards, and chapter bylaws.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Chapter overview, mission, and latest highlights.
- [Events](/events): Upcoming chapter events, balls, and gatherings.
- [Sponsorship](/sponsorship): Sponsorship tiers and how to support the chapter.
- [Board](/board): Current Thunderbird Chapter board members and leadership.
- [Awards](/awards): SCRA awards (MMA, BOM, SOM, GOM, Brevet Colonel, Wahatchee) with purpose, criteria, and submission FAQs.
- [Bylaws](/bylaws): Read the chapter bylaws in-browser or download the PDF.
